name: LabiPath
description: Labyrinth-inspired generative West-Coast voice for NTS-3. Dual corruptible 8-step sequencers drive sine/triangle oscillators into a wavefolder with FM. Hold to run; X = Corrupt (pitch then rhythm mutation), Y = Fold amount.

params.name: CORR
params.detail: Sequence corruption: pitch mutate then bit-flip

params.name: FM
params.detail: Mod-oscillator FM depth into the carrier

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Envelope decay after each generative hit
